required: Every canonical repository must have a recorded Git revision and a reviewed working-tree state.
Non-generated untracked paths must be committed, deliberately removed, or explicitly accepted before a release tag.
Generated build/cache paths are not evidence of a reproducible release and must not substitute for source and manifests.
Firmware, Core, iOS, and reference-algorithm revisions must be recorded together for a compatibility baseline.
A release requires component build/test evidence and a captured device-to-app BLE validation artifact.
not_automated_by_this_manifest: Git commits, pushes, deletions, or ignore-rule changes.
Build, test, flash, OTA, or external-service operations.
